evidence.observed_result: gzip.rs Decompressor::encode() (and brotli.rs) write decompressed bytes into a growable Vec<u8> with no maximum size; reserve() is only a capacity hint. A 12,773-byte gzip 'bomb' decompresses to 13,107,200 bytes (1026x) with no cap; the patched variant (4 MiB output cap) rejects the same input. The source comment 'cap the buf size amplification, there is a DoS risk of always allocate 3x the memory of the input buffer' shows the author capped only the reserve hint, not the actual decompressed output.
